ANALYSIS: Post‑pill anovulation (anovulatory cycles after stopping OCPs) is an endocrine/menstrual disorder causing irregular menses and possible symptoms from hormonal changes; pseudocyesis is a false belief of pregnancy with accompanying physical signs. They are different in etiology, presentation, and management and are not clinically equivalent.
